entries.title: A Claude sign-in that stops says what to try
entries.body: When Claude ends a sign-in without saying why, such as when it cannot be reached, you no longer see a bare "Login failed:". You read that the sign-in did not finish, and to check the internet connection and try again.

picture.alt: Settings, Intelligence, after a Claude sign-in stopped: the sign-in did not finish, check this Mac's internet connection, then try again
